sources.source: Private OU MST124 Unit5 Coordinate geometry and vectors
sources.inspected: Printed pp135–142: signed motion, vectors/scalars, equality, zero and negative vectors, addition; Activities23–24 and solutions p195; visible p140 layout inspected in opening release and retained
sources.fit: 4.7 velocity change; 4.9–4.10 signed sums; mathematical notation and progression throughout
sources.gap: No supplied OU mechanics chapter; vector questions calibrate mathematical reasoning only, not Newton-law physics. No private wording/figures reused.

sources.inspected: Opening friction discussion, reference frames, equilibrium, Example5.1 and Check5.2
sources.difference: Our explanation states approximate ground frame; does not claim zero vertical resultant establishes zero friction, or make unqualified universality claims.

sources.inspected: Force/acceleration and mass proportionality through Example5.2 and significance
sources.difference: Constant mass explicitly required; moving forward alone does not establish forward resultant. We distinguish velocity from acceleration rather than adopt the source significance passage’s misleading parenthetical inference.

sources.inspected: Third law, swimmer, package scale Example5.9, system change Examples5.10–5.11
sources.difference: Our original carts avoid walking/rolling force subtleties and stipulate common translation. More scaffolding before independent multi-error Activity4.12.

sources.inspected: Example7.1 and solution pp7-3–7-4, §7.1.1 inertial mass, §7.2 first law p7-5, opening §7.3 pp7-6–7-7
sources.difference: Calculus and momentum formulation deferred; no historical anecdotes or quotations adopted.

practice: Six original activities progress from signed-rate interpretation through force inference, impossible equilibrium and force-pair classification to system audit. Exact comparator questions inspected as above; 90min attempts and30feedback are editorial estimates, not measured equivalence. No extra lesson-end set.
